items.section: Dispatcher, component, and the historical hang
items.text: GamerServicesDispatcher::Update() is a permanent no-op and UpdateAsync() returns true forever after Initialize; any Begin/End pair whose action is not completed at construction would spin in the XNA-idiomatic polling loop.
items.evidence: modules/gamer-services/src/Xna/GamerServicesDispatcher.cpp (Update empty, UpdateAsync); NetworkSession.cpp, SignedInGamer.cpp, LeaderboardReader.cpp (actions completed at construction); Guide actions pending but no polling wrapper

items.text: GamerPresence's 60-entry presenceModeStrings_ table is ordered alphabetically by mode name, but setPresenceModeProperty indexes it by the GamerPresenceMode ordinal (None=0 maps to 'Arcade Mode'); the selected string is currently unobservable (private, passed only to the empty SetPresenceModeStringEXT). Whether FNA shares the ordering was not checked.

Achievement earnedTicks, leaderboard ratings and int64 columns are stored as JSON doubles and lose low bits above 2^53 (2026 ticks rounded to 128-tick steps), while LocalGamerServicesStore.hpp documents earned ticks as an exact round trip.
The synchronous LeaderboardReader::Read/PageDown/PageUp wrappers never delete the action their Begin* allocates, unlike GetProfile/GetAchievements, leaking one small object per call.
Fourteen Guide Show* entry points plus DelayNotifications are empty no-ops (no local shell UI for sign-in, friends, marketplace, messages, party, gamer card, achievements).
Achievement catalogue metadata (name, description, gamer score) is never populated and Achievement::GetPicture() throws NotImplementedException.
Presence is never published (empty SetPresenceModeStringEXT) and GamerPrivileges is a fixed permissive constant that nothing enforces; GamerProfile is synthetic except Region.
No online service: no authentication, friends graph, matchmaking or remote account exists; GetFriends is empty and gamertag lookup throws. Architectural decision, not a defect.

items.section: Path containment and the remaining glob gap
items.text: StorageContainer path operations had no containment check (fs::path(storagePath_) / relative), letting '../' or absolute paths escape the container.
items.evidence: modules/storage/src/StorageContainer.cpp (constructor ResolveContainedPath; ResolveNativePath -> ResolveContainedNativePathFromBase for every path method); StorageDeviceTests.cpp (ContainerOperationsRejectLexicalEscapes, ContainerOperationsRejectSymlinkEscapes, ContainerOpenRejectsPathsOutsideStorageRoot)

items.section: Path containment and the remaining glob gap
items.text: The hand-written GlobMatch behind GetFileNames(pattern)/GetDirectoryNames(pattern) has no test of its semantics (empty matches, literal dots, non-ASCII names, multiple wildcards, long names).
StorageContainer::OpenFile discards its FileShare argument; FileStream has no share mode and no cross-process lock, so FileShare::None does not exclude other writers.
No C++ storage test writes bytes through a StorageContainer stream and reads them back; only the C ABI smoke test (C ABI builds only) does.
StorageContainer methods keep working after Dispose (no disposed check); XNA's behaviour after disposal was not checked here.
Under Emscripten no persistent filesystem is mounted (no IDBFS/syncfs in the tree), so storage and the GamerServices store are lost on page reload.
items.evidence: grep of TARGET tree (excluding third_party/vendor) for IDBFS|syncfs|FS.mount: no hits

items.text: Container and file operations do not translate host errors into StorageDeviceNotConnectedException (only root creation and space queries do); documented boundary.
Local and LocalWithLeaderboards sessions deliver no packets at all, not even between local gamers; PlayerMatch/Ranked/JoinInvited are refused.
LocalNetworkGamer::ReceiveData(PacketReader&, NetworkGamer*&) always returns 0 (preserved FNA quirk).

ReceiveData(PacketReader&) writes the packet at position 0 of the reader's stream without truncating it, so reusing one PacketReader for a shorter packet after a longer one appears to leave stale trailing bytes and an old Length (depends on sharp-runtime MemoryStream::Write, read at a sibling revision).
items.evidence: modules/net/src/Xna/LocalNetworkGamer.cpp (ReceiveData PacketReader overload); sharp-runtime (sibling, not pinned) MemoryStream::Write

items.text: NetworkSessionAction reports CompletedSynchronously == false although it is completed before Begin* returns.
A joining machine's session is constructed with MaxSupportedGamers (31) and four private slots (FNA FIXME placeholders), so a client's MaxGamers/PrivateGamerSlots do not mirror the host's.
Voice (EnableSendVoice, SendPartyInvites), NetworkMachine::RemoveFromSession, arbitration/TrueSkill events and QualityOfService bandwidth are unimplemented.
On Emscripten, LAN discovery is a no-op, hosting is only meaningful for a Node.js relay (fixed port 61191), and Join returns before the handshake.

Process-spawning transport and dispatcher tests are compiled out on Windows, Emscripten, Android and iOS; multi-machine discovery/migration, Windows shared-port binding and browser paths have no test evidence.
The non-const NetworkSessionProperties indexer appends a slot on any out-of-range access (documented, accepted divergence; const access and getItem are strict).

Dispose(bool) visibility: AvatarRenderer's Dispose(bool) is protected at TARGET, but Accelerometer, Gyroscope, Compass and Motion still declare Dispose(bool) public while SensorBase declares it protected, so an external Dispose(false) reaches the base path that marks the sensor disposed without cleanup.
items.evidence: modules/gamer-services/include/Microsoft/Xna/Framework/GamerServices/AvatarRenderer.hpp (protected Dispose(bool)); modules/devices/include/Microsoft/Devices/Sensors/Accelerometer.hpp, Gyroscope.hpp, Compass.hpp, Motion.hpp (public Dispose(bool)); SensorBase.hpp (protected virtual Dispose(bool)); modules/devices/src/Sensors/Accelerometer.cpp (!disposing branch)

items.text: The bundled procedural avatar's garment shells interpenetrate the body (collar and cuffs visible; shirt 64/228 vertices crossing), per CNA's own record; four remedies were measured and reverted.

Avatar rendering evidence is three pixel programs on EasyGL and Vulkan using a synthetic one-bone quad; no renderer test validates the bundled 19-bone content, and no other renderer registers the programs.
SkinnedModelEXT::AttachPartEXT only checks BoneCount equality; a different skeleton with the same bone count is not detected.
docs/avatar-real-rendering-ext.md's renderer table still says Vulkan was not yet smoke-tested although the Vulkan examples CMake registers the three avatar programs (documentation staleness in CNA).

items.section: Avatar: Faithful Absence and CNAEXT Rendering
items.text: The XNA avatar API is inert (State Unavailable, Draw no-op, zero descriptions/animations) by fidelity to the reference assembly without its service; not a defect.
TitleContainer has no in-tree consumer, so its Android asset fallback is unreachable from content loading.
items.evidence: modules/content/src/Xna/ContentManager.cpp (Android branch: TryReadAssetBytes through the platform filesystem TryLoadFileIgnoringCase, independent of TitleContainer); TitleContainer/TitleLocation used only by modules/c-api/src/CnaCApiGameProperties.cpp

items.text: ResourceContentManager::OpenStream was a non-dispatching stub that threw 'not implemented' and was never called by ContentManager.
items.evidence: modules/content/src/Xna/ResourceContentManager.cpp (OpenStream reads ResourceManager::GetObject bytes into a MemoryStream); ContentManager.hpp (virtual OpenStream used by ReadAsset)
